title: Tabs with React Router
description: Tabs whose selection lives in the route with React Router: each Tab renders a Link that does the navigation, Tabs reads selectedId from useLocation and draws no outer edge with $outerEdge={false}, and a single TabPanel renders the matched child route through Outlet. selectOnMove={false} keeps arrow keys from adding history entries, so Enter or a click follows the focused link, and a Back button over a memory router shows one entry for each selection. Use it for client-side routing with React Router, and use the App Router version in a Next.js app.
